candidate: dsh-autoresearch durable evaluator attempt handoff / crash recovery substrate

verified_positive_evidence.claim: Stable physical attempt identity is created before evaluator dispatch.
verified_positive_evidence.evidence: controller.ts derives attemptId as <experimentId>-attempt-<attemptOrdinal>; runEvaluator persists spawn intent before artifact writer minting and before subprocess.spawn. evaluator.spec.ts explicitly requires failed persistSpawnIntent to prevent artifact capability minting and spawn.

verified_positive_evidence.claim: Attempt outcome and evaluator artifacts are recorded transactionally and immutable once set.
verified_positive_evidence.evidence: tracker.ts schema version 6 uses WAL plus BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions; recordAttemptOutcome rejects a second durable outcome, merges process observations, writes outcome_json and inserts attempt-scoped artifacts within one transaction.

verified_positive_evidence.claim: Recovery fails closed when whole-process-tree quiescence is not durably proven.
verified_positive_evidence.evidence: recovery.ts blocks with attempt-uncertain whenever process_tree_quiescent != 1 and retains the lock. A proven-quiescent attempt lacking durable outcome/artifacts may be rerun under the next attempt ordinal; the controller stops after the bounded recovery rerun budget.

verified_positive_evidence.claim: The audited source is still the current public master.
verified_positive_evidence.evidence: A SHA-only Git ref read during this audit resolved refs/heads/master to ab7882ee75eed454d311ddd16fd81902aeb3cd61.

new_structural_reproduction.finding: There is an unavoidable prepare-to-observe ambiguity window in the current local-subprocess handoff.
proof: History A: createAttemptIntent commits durable spawn intent, then the controller process dies before subprocess.spawn executes.
History B: createAttemptIntent commits durable spawn intent, subprocess.spawn succeeds, then the controller process dies before persistSpawnObserved commits providerPid/spawnedAt.
At the recovery boundary both histories can present the same durable attempt row: spawn intent exists; providerPid/spawnedAt/process_tree_quiescent/outcome are unset.
recovery.ts therefore cannot distinguish A from B from its own durable state. It correctly chooses fail-closed attempt-uncertain rather than rerunning and risking a duplicate evaluator in B.
new_structural_reproduction.consequence: The current mechanism strongly supports at-most-one-concurrent-attempt safety, but not strong exactly-once completion. A harmless pre-spawn controller death can be permanently indistinguishable from a spawned-but-unobserved evaluator. Progress across this window needs an external supervisor/receipt, provider idempotency, or an atomic dispatch primitive whose durable identity can be reconciled independently of the controller process.
new_structural_reproduction.scope: This is a source-level state-machine result for the audited local subprocess boundary. It does not show a production incident and does not imply duplicate evaluation occurs under normal operation.

important_scope_corrections.correction: Physical-attempt durability should not be described as fully exactly-once.
important_scope_corrections.reason: Safety is fail-closed across ambiguous handoff, but liveness/settlement is not guaranteed. The source proves a conservative at-most-once/unknown state, not a two-sided exactly-once protocol.

important_scope_corrections.correction: Logical held-out evaluation consumption is still a separate missing layer.
important_scope_corrections.reason: A proven-quiescent attempt with no durable outcome may be rerun with a new physical attempt ordinal. No stable logical query id, monotone held-out-query charge, alpha/e-value state, cross-candidate spending ledger or selection-unused outer-test channel was found in the audited paths.

important_scope_corrections.correction: Current recovery correctness is stronger than an older public bug report, but that report is not independent replication.
important_scope_corrections.reason: Repository issue #7 documented that an older revision reparsed redacted stdout on recovery. The current audited revision stores the parsed attempt result in outcome_json and reconstructs from durable outcome data, so that exact defect is repaired; the report and fix are first-party.
README still says DurableTracker schema v5 while audited tracker.ts exports TRACKER_SCHEMA_VERSION = 6. This is documentation drift, not evidence of a runtime schema defect.

reproducibility_assessment.what_is_strong: Exact current source, current master identity, lockfile, schema, transaction ordering, fail-closed recovery and official integration/unit tests are all publicly inspectable and source-bound.
reproducibility_assessment.what_remains_missing: Real controller SIGKILL injection at each prepare/spawn/observed/outcome boundary; independently observed provider/OS receipt that resolves the prepare-to-observe ambiguity; stable logical evaluation identity above attempts; monotone statistical/query consumption; protocol-matched third-party rerun.
reproducibility_assessment.promotion_recommendation: Use dsh-autoresearch as a concrete durability substrate, but do not cite it as evidence of logical-query exactly-once or statistically safe repeated adaptive evaluation.
